title: One noisy cellular automaton with an uncomputable noise diagram
description: We construct one computably specified finite-alphabet, finite-range cellular automaton on Z^3 with computable disjoint nonempty rational rate windows. Throughout the nth window, uniform whole-symbol replacement is ergodic exactly when a fixed universal machine halts on n. Halting gives exponential full-symbol coalescence over all starts, with a fixed positive computable decay coefficient and an effective halting-dependent prefactor uniform on each window; nonhalting gives two stationary laws invariant under every spatial translation. A corner-deterministic chart, causal L-frame computations, history strips, private interval sensors and a packed wrong-gate boundary give the construction. Its fixed finite-range {0,1}-energy space-time interaction on Z^4 has computable rational inverse-temperature windows: halting is equivalent to uniqueness among all Gibbs measures and gives exponential weak spatial mixing in arbitrary volumes. Earlier results on Z^4, Z^5, Z^6 and Z^7 are retained. Lean verifies the stated original six-dimensional results; the three- and four-dimensional automaton results are not formalized.
notes: Preprint. It has not been peer reviewed. Version 1.4.0 updates version 1.3.0 (10.5281/zenodo.24178271). New Section 11: Theorem E, one fixed finite-alphabet finite-range automaton on Z^3 with computable rational rate windows on which it is ergodic exactly when a universal machine halts, with exponential all-input coalescence at one fixed computable rate on halting windows; and Corollary F, one fixed {0,1}-energy interaction on Z^4 whose uniqueness among all Gibbs measures on computable windows is equivalent to halting. The Z^3 parameters are certified by two independent exact-arithmetic programs (verification/z3-scale/).
